review.scope: Historical illustrated garden before the current sky panorama
review.direction: Earlier airy layered garden with clouds and low edge foliage framing a quiet playfield
review.inspection: Selected original PNGs inspected individually, including cloud1, treeLong and bushAlt1; source comparison sheet is review material only
review.status: Historical validation: source artwork and copied image identity verified. Earlier garden composition and readability reviewed for both modes at 320 x 568, 393 x 852, 852 x 393 and 1473 x 1175. Native gameplay, former cloud lifecycle, reduced-motion and static drawing cache checks passed. Chromium and simulated iPhone WebKit gameplay and layout checks passed; the Chromium Words reload case passed on retry with a 180-second suite limit. Current panorama validation is recorded in docs/assets/jelly-sky.md.
review.note: foliage.png is the original bushAlt1 low shrub artwork, used as perimeter foliage
